page0.text:
Let's patrol Shinto.
We can't let our guard down, even if Caster has been defeated.
I need to find the still-unknown Master of Lancer and determine their intent.

page1.text:
"We're going to Shinto. Come with me, Saber."
"Understood. Is the plan the same as yesterday?"
"Yeah. I'll act helpless until we lure out an enemy."

page2.text:
I turn off the living room lights.
So as not to wake Sakura, I slip out of the house as quietly as I can.

page3.text: We spend about an hour patrolling the town, but fail to turn up anything of note.

page4.text:
According to Saber, the magical energy threads that Caster had throughout Shinto have largely thinned out, but I can't sense such subtle changes.
Since there's no obvious traces of energy in Shinto, it looks like there isn't another Master there...

page5.text:
"What is the matter, Shirou? You seem unhappy about something."
"Huh...? Oh, not really. I just thought the train station feels pretty empty. It's almost like..."

page6.text:
...a ghost town, I almost say.
...It's probably just a fluke.
Nothing out of the ordinary happened tonight. There are just fewer people out than usual.

page7.text:
"Let's go home, Saber. I don't think we'll learn anything else walking around aimlessly."
"...Yes. You still aren't feeling well, so let us retire early tonight."

page8.text:
We leave Shinto behind.
The hollow echo of our footsteps is the only sound in the terminal.
